Style gallery

Every visual style this skill can draw in. Each preview below is a live frame of the real template file, so nothing here can drift from what the skill actually produces.

15 of 15 styles ship a base template; the rest are composed from snippets.

Hand-Drawn Sketch shipped

hand-drawn-sketch · needs-js · roughjs@4

warm; informal; whiteboard-marker colors; muted pastel fills with dark ink outlines

Best for
brainstorming sessions; early-stage architecture docs; workshop collab boards; informal proposals
Avoid for
formal client-facing deliverables; print-ready technical specs; high-density diagrams over 40 nodes
Typography
Excalifont or Caveat/Gochi Hand for labels; handwritten feel
Motion
connection-draw-in, dash-flow, pulse-glow, node-boot-sequence +8 more

Flat Minimal shipped

flat-minimal · css-only

restrained 2-3 brand accents plus neutral grays; generous whitespace reads calm and professional

Best for
public-facing architecture docs; SaaS product docs; investor decks; onboarding guides
Avoid for
dense low-level infra topology; playful or informal contexts; retro or nostalgic themes
Typography
Inter or Geist for all labels; medium weight for node names; regular for annotations
Motion
